title: Country Perspectives Mexico’s Journey
content: Mexico’s Journey in the “Unlocking IP-backed Financing Series” looks at initial steps towards the development and implementation of an IP-backed financing ecosystem. The study also highlights the value of providing better access to reliable information on the ownership, encumbrances and legal status of IP rights. Together with stronger valuation practices, clearer recovery procedures and practical pilot initiatives, these measures could help to build confidence and experience in IP-backed financing. Overall, the study provides a practical basis for strengthening the conditions for the use of IP as a financial asset in Mexico.
